usage: icebath auth [-h] {add,list,remove,reset,priority,refresh,status,logout,upgrade} ...

positional arguments:
  {add,list,remove,reset,priority,refresh,status,logout,upgrade}
    add                 Add a pooled credential
    list                List pooled credentials
    remove              Remove a pooled credential by index, id, or label
    reset               Clear exhaustion status for a provider's credentials (all, or one target)
    priority            Move a pooled credential to a priority (0 = tried first under fill_first)
    refresh             Refresh a pooled OAuth credential's tokens and clear its cooldown
    status              Show auth status for a provider
    logout              Log out a provider and clear stored auth state
    upgrade             Sign in with a Nous account, keeping your connectors

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
